title: App crashes on login
body: The app crashes every time I try to log in with my Google account. Error: NullPointerException.

title: Add dark mode
body: It would be great to have a dark mode option in settings. Many users have requested this.

title: How do I export data?
body: I can't find the export button. Is there a way to export my data to CSV?

title: Database connection timeout
body: Getting frequent timeout errors when the database has more than 1000 records. Seems like a performance issue.

title: Add bulk import
body: Please add a feature to bulk import users via CSV. This is critical for onboarding large teams.

title: What is the rate limit?
body: What is the API rate limit for the free tier? I couldn't find this in the docs.

title: Login button unresponsive on mobile
body: On iOS Safari, the login button doesn't respond to taps. Works fine on Chrome.

title: Support OAuth2
body: We need OAuth2 support for enterprise SSO integration. Currently only username/password works.

title: How to reset password?
body: I forgot my password. The reset email never arrived. What should I do?

title: Memory leak in API server
body: The API server memory usage grows continuously and never releases. Needs to be fixed urgently.
